messages.author: saamson
messages.content_text:
PSYCHOLOGICAL ANALYSIS
I properly assessed the risk and agreed with myself that i am okay putting my money on this, as it seemed pretty probable. Though now i'm not sure if i have a good frame of what is A+ or not for this model. I still think it was at least an A setup, but starting to feel a bit of doubt with grading this trade. As it tagged my in, i did feel some adrenaline, heart beating a bit but was quite aware of it. felt pretty good as price was going my way, but as it reversed i did feel some angst but caught it and did some breathing to regain composure. I did move my stop from 30 pt to where the low is, and then pulled it back to 30pts for breathing room. Not sure if i should've pulled it back, i felt like i should've pulled it to nearest low, and then not touch it again. i pulled it back down out of fear, so i want to note that here. was about a 30 dollar difference but still, principle applies. a bit bummed the trade didn't play out, blew an account from that. just wasn't my session and i accept that. there will be more to come. now am a bit worried as there are 2 accounts that are about to be blown if the next trade loses. honestly shouldn't let something like that deter my confidence. i have 4 accounts with decent drawdown on apex, and that's a good amount already to get me right.  other than that, i followed my rules here. its just the probability that didn't play, there may have been some hole in my logic in assessing this trade, but overall did fine. Could be a lot better. On the bright side, this is the only loss of the entire week. no urge of revenge trading, so that's good. No FOMO, so that's awesome too. Even after fading that 10 am short i was chilling. but yea just bummed, got my hopes up when i was in the green and got humbled right after. (edited)

29/05/2026 NQ

Bias: Bullish
I came bullish into the day since price is in ATH and trading higher. At 9:30 ATH got taken and I was anticipating a retrace to go higher.

messages.author: saamson
messages.content_text:
DAY 7  : 1 TRADE 1 L

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
Bias was bullish, and was coming from a 2.5 range on a HTF stdv. Waited for price to retrace off the 2/2.5 range and come down to reblance an fvg. Price did come down, right from 10am. there was a short play from the key open but i faded it because ATH but played out wonderfully. Though that one was a bit of a gamble. My actual trade lied in the OTE of the range aligned with a FVG, Breaker, and VAL/LVN of the VP. 30 PT stop to cover .79 and breaker invalidation range. Price reacted well off of the level, tapped POI. had BE located at near swing high on 1 min. Was close to BE level, but price retraced, created REH and stopped me out. I was under the impression that we were bullish still and how -4 has not been hit. Maybe my analysis was a bit off because the FVG was on the 15 min(?) but if anything that should hold more power. On top of that, the higher TF stdv had price close above 2.5 which led me to also believe that price would not come back down. it in fact did(where my entry was), which may have been an indication price would go bearish. So this may have been the deciding factor of an A+ setup or not. Not entirely sure, but everything else appeared right. Something to review with boy. also it was a 70 pt move, maybe that was it too. (edited)
Friday, May 29, 2026 at 10:47 AM

I broke my rules on my last attempt so I am starting over. 

STRAT: 
Strategy:

MMXM Framework 

Tools: 
SMT (not my favorite so don't need to stress to hard on this one) 

Finding the Bias and POI for the day

FIB for targets and reversal zones.

FVG w/RB that has some sort of EL inside for first entry annnd a fib alignment for better probability

TFA for model filtering

If no good setups wait for 10KO and try find the reversal or continuation entry. 

Not organized by step order 

—————

Variable to Strat: 

Potential to trade during London if I find it works better

RR : minimum: 3

Max ideal RR: 10

—————

Stop loss rules:

HARD STOP + MANUAL STOP method

—————

Trading Rules:

A/A+ setups only

1 full win (fully done)

1 loss (can take another if A+)

2 loss = LOCKOUT
 

Rules 

Max 2 trades a day and off after a win and or 1-2 losses. (edited)

messages.author: JackHenderson
messages.content_text:
Day 6 - 29/05/26 (1H RB MMSM) (Loss)


Getting onto the chart I saw that price had rallied quite strongly to the upside and had not yet rebalanced discount of the current price leg, along with that midnight open also had not been revisited and was resting above discount level giving me further confidence in price revisiting this area.
,


I saw price gave an aggressive initial reaction to the sell side after tapping into CE of a 1H RB that followed my criteria but I had not taken an entry from this level . When I saw that there was a clean 5m Breaker block set in at this level after price had sold off and it wasn’t yet tapped into, I attached the STDV tool from the high to the breaker and awaited what happened at the -1 STDV range.
,


Price gave s short accumulation after meeting this range and started delivering back up to the bayside. 18:00 open aligned within this breaker as-well as OTE of this selloff leg so I set a LMT short just below 18:00 with my TP targeting an internal low just above the -2 STDV level and my SL above 0.79 of this selloff leg and the breaker.
,


There was a good initial reaction to this trade but unfortunately price continued bullish after meeting 02:00 stopping me out and taking this internal high.
,

Price will likely still deliver to my target but I was too early and we either wanted to take this internal high first or ATH.

messages.author: Rupert
messages.content_text:
Make my trading simple 

Only look on the charts around when a 4hr candle opens such as 2am ish 6amish 10am ish or 2pm ish so hop on 30 mins before see the structure if theres something to take take it if not dont

Look for a 5m or higher RB find what it reject off making it valid.

If it aligns with OTE or SMT and has good risk limit if not then ET the level using 1m RB or 5m 

If really strong DOL and bias hold for longer if not go for low hanging fruit and don’t get greedy 

With 10am and 2pm KOs make sure it has the correct minipulation then either limit the level of the risk is right if not just ET (for 10am and 2pm can use 1m RB as long as the minipulation is there)

Then my risk still is the same and if i miss the move/get left behind be more carefull and picky with the next trade in that session (edited)

messages.author: NS Picklo
messages.content_text:
Strategy: 

-bias : ko for olhc/ohlc , nwog/ndog as snr + potential dol , pxl/h , htf momentum and smts

-setup model : manipulation of some kind (if before 10am price manipulates into a key area then 10am will most likely expand without having to leave much of a wick) , into a htf pda + ltf pda , ote of range in the oposing direction to dol, (only use 0.5 if theres smt and 5min rb) . some form of amd should be involved in the trade , 

-10am model : when 9:30 open doesnt do a lot its most likely saving the volotility for the next 4hr candle to open for a po3 setup , same model as mentioned before but if its not a complete A+ setup with price manipulating opposite side of the ko first then wait for a close on the side that you want to trade in and limit the level aslong as the RR is worth it (if not use et) especially if theres smt , (there has to be some kind of manipulation for a p03 trade though as thats the whole premise of the 10am model)

-entry model : if everything is looking good A/A+ trade , wait for 1-5min rb to take entry , changes throughout trades due to discretion but if less confident with the trade wait for 5min rb and use fib on 1min range + another smt makes it A+ . also consider tfa when looking for entry 4hr pda = 15min entry 1hr pda = 5min entry 15min pda = 1min entry  , make sure to plot position for an appropriate RR 

—————
Stop loss rules:

trail to be when it makes sense or just 30pt 
trail to lows/highs put in that it wouldnt make sense to return to

—————
Trading Rules:

only trade after 9:30 until 11:00
minimum RR = 5
if pa is bad/hard to read = lockout 
execute on the stronger asset if bullish , weaker asset if bearish
only enter without entry trigger on a 10am ko setup 
A/A+ setups only
1 full win (fully done)
1 partial + runner be (can take another if A+ )
1 loss (can take another if A+)
2 loss = LOCKOUT (edited)

-setup model : manipulation of some kind (if before 10am price manipulates into a key area then 10am will most likely expand without having to leave much of a wick) , into a htf pda + ltf pda , ote of range in the oposing direction to dol, (only use 0.5 if theres smt and 5min rb) . some form of amd should be involved in the trade , 

-10am model : when 9:30 open doesnt do a lot its most likely saving the volotility for the next 4hr candle to open for a po3 setup , same model as mentioned before but if its not a complete A+ setup with price manipulating opposite side of the ko first then wait for a close on the side that you want to trade in and limit the level aslong as the RR is worth it (if not use et) especially if theres smt , (there has to be some kind of manipulation for a p03 trade though as thats the whole premise of the 10am model)

-entry model : if everything is looking good A/A+ trade , wait for 1-5min rb to take entry , changes throughout trades due to discretion but if less confident with the trade wait for 5min rb and use fib on 1min range + another smt makes it A+ . also consider tfa when looking for entry 4hr pda = 15min entry 1hr pda = 5min entry 15min pda = 1min entry  , make sure to plot position for an appropriate RR 

—————
Stop loss rules:

trail to be when it makes sense or just 30pt 
trail to lows/highs put in that it wouldnt make sense to return to

—————
Trading Rules:

only trade after 9:30 until 11:00
minimum RR = 5
if pa is bad/hard to read = lockout 
execute on the stronger asset if bullish , weaker asset if bearish
only enter without entry trigger on a 10am ko setup 
A/A+ setups only
1 full win (fully done)
1 partial + runner be (can take another if A+ )
1 loss (can take another if A+)
2 loss = LOCKOUT (edited)

messages.author: Andrey Smirnov
messages.content_text:
28/05/2026 NQ

Bias: Bullish
PXH PXL suggested PDL which already got taken and price traded inside a Daily FVG, Price is also trading in ATH.
Looking at 4h Structure, Price made a Bullish SMT with ES but left relative equal lows with an unfilled NWOG. ES already tapped the NWOG
At open I still wanted a retrace lower to target my DOL.
DOL: My DOL for the Day was the 18:00 swing high it stood out to me since I was bullish
What I saw: I saw several 1m ET form right at Discount and at 0.62, I took none of them bc price displaced heavily off open and I decided to wait for 10:00 and for some structure before engaging in longs.
Why I sat out: At 10:00, price traded lower but did not trade into anything significant and then at 10:12, news got released which took my DOL instantly. 
Lesson: Patience paid off today (edited)
Friday, May 29, 2026 at 10:34 AM

messages.content_text: Okay so for today i found something out that in fact should have been logical but at least i learned it trough experience. Basically for today i was bullish. but for 10am at first cuz a nice 5min RB was made. but it did not close bearish but a doji so skipped that. did not look at the 1min but i wanted us to react off the 4h RB which we did and i wanted longs but i wanted a bit more of an expanion and then higher but iran and usa news dropped. But what i found out powell looks at the entry directly and he had a limit at 10am which at first interesting but when i though about it, we were rebalanced on 1min TF and he used the range that formed immediately after tapping the 4h RB (white line) and i did not see it cuz i was looking at the 5min TF. but i see after the PD array tap and he used the fib and just wanted higher and limited 10am. So yeah bassically 10am is. desired pd array at open (5min RB or 15min or 4h) 10am open and tap into pd array. wait for reaction above and use fib. messages.author: saamson
messages.content_text:
Day 6.5  3 trades 3 L (eval)

Technical Analysis
Bias at first was bearish, considering a downtrend we were in, setting up the mmsm but trump candle came in and ran through key levels. so that left me to believe that we were now bullish. I was waiting for retrace into imbalance after external liquidity had been swept, but there was basically none in discount. only one was in premium. an smt was also made, so i wanted to go long but there was no opening. stdv hit -2.5 range which had price consolidate, i believe that price should've retraced soon and deliver up, so i placed a trade anticipating that. but two things; bias was extremely bullish and both indexes were decorreclated. probability was at absolute low. logically now it doesn't make sense to short in these conditions. thought that price would retrace off of OTE levels on the big swing but did not. I disregarded the fact that price was going to reach the -4 level. best thing to do was to not place any entry. there was no a+ setup that i saw. wouldn't even make sense gambling it

psychological analysis
I feel a bit peeved at the fact that i took those, even if they were on eval. I don't want to have that habit seep through into my actual trading cause my mind/emotions can not tell the difference. from a logical standpoint, i shouldn't have been looking for shorts after the first one failed, but there was that part of me that felt that it would still retrace. so doubling down on false logic is a bit of a hole in my psych. Also wasn't really considering the amount of risk, sure it isn't real money but seeing it at -750 is a bit of a gut punch for me. and then the part of my brain tells me, you have to win it back. still difficult to sit with losses or big ones at least. I think once i get into the motion of trading more than once, it happens. I was also not weighing my risk, and a bit of ego was put into there so yea definitely lit a fuse but put stopped before i blew it. key would be to spot this before it goes

messages.content_text:
Day 18
5/28/26
Recap: +6.36R +153pts

Coming into today I feel much rested, been busy with my family but I got some solid sleep last night. I traded a little bit last night unfortunately and broke my rules. Fortunately though I made money. So I'll just be observing and only wait for A+ setups and be risk off. 

We are trading towards ATHs, 1h looks bullish. We do have that NWOG below still. We are close to some BSL, we could sweep that setting an SMT then trade lower targetting the NWOG or see if we can get a reversal at open then take a continuation toawrds the buyside and ATH.

Off open we have double bearish SMTs, we are trading lower now towards OTE. Here soon at the macro I'll have to see if this is a trend changing to the lows or if we will hold OTE. 
We've tapped into OTE and have entered the macro with a bullish 1m SMT, If we get signs for a clean reversal setup I will take it.

Once we filled OTE, we got a BoS + Displacement then retraced into OTE of the LTF range up. That is where I entered with about a 24 pt SL. My tp wasn't clearly defined yet, but I was targeting a 1:3 minimum. And as you can see price looked really strong, I trailed to my entry low so it was pretty much a risk free trade. We inverted the 5m so i decided to hold longet toward the HOD when we get that 100pt candle straight to TP.

Another clean day of execution, no hesitation, no emotional actions. Just 1 and done and its a banger. I will say I did micromanage a bit moving around my Sl and Tp trying to see what I was comfortable with but in th end it didn't directly mess with my trade.

messages.author: Big_Sixty60
messages.content_text: Caught the entire market open short almost perfectly off the VAH rejection and opening imbalance, with ES/MNQ confirming weakness and rotation lower into the POC area along with sing print highs. Bias, entry, and overall execution were correct, and I even gave the signal live beforehand. The only mistake was placing my take profit too precisely on NQ during high volatility conditions, getting missed by less than a point before price reversed and stopped me out at break even. This trade reinforced that my market read and auction understanding were accurate, but I need to adapt my profit-taking strategy to account for NQ’s tendency to front-run key liquidity targets by a few points. @boy @kp

messages.author: Luke
messages.content_text:
Day 12 - Loss

Bias today was bearish due to NWOG still being untapped on NQ, Low resistance liquidity and equal lows.

Waited for 10am to open, had what I thought was manipulation higher into M15 SIBI and 0.5 of range.

Price came below 10am and then left a rejection block in line with KO off of 0.62 fib level. Had Bearish SMT where ES swept high but NQ wasn’t even close, this gave me some confirmation for the trade.

This was my entry targeting swing low.

SL hit. I stuck to my rules so still a winning day in my eyes. Maybe need to be more patient going forward but still a decent trade in my eyes.

Will watch domes recap later to see what is outlook on the day was.

Some news candle of fukerey has appeared and just rallied. Price clearly already had its direction in mind.

Emotions  - Today overall felt okay, did semi struggle with my bias before the trade.

A little bit of disappointment once the trade lost and I realised that the true bias for the day should have been bullish. 

Dommes recap helped clear up where I was wrong and what I should have been looking at. (edited)

messages.author: Andrey Smirnov
messages.content_text:
Strategy: 

Always along with a HTF Bias

For Bias I use PXH PXl, Market Maker Models and a top down Analysis 

For Key levels and entries I use Powell’s Model with EL, Key open, Rejection Blocks and FIB

DOL identified before the session always

Minimum RR 1:3, ideal 1:5 on average 

Risk management:
if 1st trade is a win, done for the day
If 1st trade is a loss, I give myself another opportunity with half risk
No matter the outcome for the second trade, I am done for the day

I don’t trade on Bank Holidays, No news Mondays, or before a high impact news release.
